2026 has already been a bloody good year for the genre with Resident Evil Requiem and Silent Hill: Townfall leading the rabble.
But this autumn sees a festering surge of indie horror releases, featuring everything from cursed card games to Nazi-hunting penguins.

stories.title: ‘My social life completely plummeted’: gen Z is fighting back against big tech
